source.zh: CAYE_咖啡机故障对策速查手册_V7（奶泵模组 F28/F30/F31/F32）+《维修手册》第 3 章 牛奶模组
source.en: CAYE Fault Countermeasure Handbook V7 (milk module F28/F30/F31/F32) + Service Manual ch.3 (milk module)

why.zh: 奶管折弯、被柜门压住、脱落或未插到底；奶量少时塑料接头浮在液面，一半吸奶一半吸空气 → 抽奶不畅，奶温忽高忽低。
why.en: Milk hose kinked, pinched by the cabinet door, disconnected or not fully seated; with low milk the coupling floats at the surface drawing air with the milk.

act.zh: 理顺并插紧奶管、去掉奶箱出奶口多余橡胶垫、更换合适奶箱、保证牛奶冷藏 2–4℃ 后复测。
act.en: Straighten and fully seat the hose, remove the extra gasket at the tank outlet, fit a proper tank, keep milk at 2–4°C, then retest.

why.zh: 牛奶未冷藏（常温奶），进奶温度本身就在 20–30℃，直接抬高出口温度与稳定性。
why.en: Milk not chilled — the inlet is already 20–30°C, which lifts outlet temperature and hurts repeatability.

act.zh: 门店冷藏 2–4℃ 并确认未过期；热奶饮进奶 ≤10℃、冷奶饮 ≤5℃。
act.en: Store: chill to 2–4°C within shelf life; inlet ≤10°C for hot drinks, ≤5°C for cold.

why.zh: 奶输送（两通隔膜）电磁阀动作异常或内漏，进奶路径被干扰；进奶温度偏高时应优先排查奶泵前段（奶管、两通隔膜电磁阀及进奶路径）。
why.en: The milk delivery (2-way diaphragm) valve mis-acts or leaks internally, disturbing the inlet path; when the inlet runs warm, inspect the pump-inlet section first.

act.zh: 服务商拆检阀体与膜片，更换 FFKM 最新件；换件后重新做奶温校准。
act.en: Service: open the valve, inspect body and diaphragm, fit the latest FFKM part, then re-calibrate.

why.zh: 进奶 NTC 漂移或线束接触不良，读数失真导致温度补偿算错，泵速与加热量整体偏移。
why.en: Inlet NTC drift or a loose harness skews the reading so the compensation mis-drives pump speed and heating.

act.zh: 清洁探头、插紧接插件；退 pin 或水腐蚀需导入一体式线束并重新校准。
act.en: Clean the probe and reseat connectors; for backed-out pins or corrosion adopt the one-piece harness and re-calibrate.

why.zh: IOT 牛奶温度补偿值被写入异常大数（泵速异常偏高，例如 2800 rpm），出奶约 65℃ 但转速不合理。
why.en: The IOT milk temperature compensation was written as an abnormal large number (e.g. 2800 rpm) — outlet ≈65°C but the speed is unrealistic.

act.zh: 按软件 Bug 处理：把牛奶温度补偿值改为 0，再复测并重新校准。
act.en: Treat as a software bug: set the milk temperature compensation value to 0, then retest and re-calibrate.

why.zh: 出奶 NTC 漂移，显示温度虚高，实际奶温正常但读数偏高、易触发过温保护。
why.en: Outlet NTC drift makes the reading run high — the milk is fine but the display (and over-heat logic) is not.

act.zh: 万用表测 NTC 阻值判定，损坏则更换并重新校准。
act.en: Measure the NTC resistance to judge; replace if failed and re-calibrate.

why.zh: 蒸汽加热室进汽量过大，或混合腔单向阀卡滞在旁通位，导致过度加热。
why.en: Too much steam into the heating chamber, or a check valve stuck bypassed, over-heats the milk.

act.zh: 拆检单向阀与蒸汽通路结垢情况，清洁/更换后重校准。
act.en: Inspect the check valve and steam path for scale, clean or replace, then re-calibrate.

why.zh: 排废三通隔膜阀的密封头膨胀 / 老化，密封不良导致奶温偏低且杯量偏少——典型表现是出奶只有 20 多℃ 且奶量明显不足。
why.en: The 3-way drain valve seal head has expanded or aged, so the milk path leaks: outlet only ~20–25°C with low cup volume — the classic cold-milk signature.

act.zh: 更换 FKM / FFKM 材质密封件或整个三通总成；换件后重新做奶温校准，连续出杯验证 65±3℃。
act.en: Replace the FKM/FFKM seal head or the whole valve, re-run milk-temp calibration and verify 65±3°C over several cups.

why.zh: 奶泵蒸汽单向阀卡滞或密封损坏，蒸汽无法在设定位置与牛奶充分混合 → 奶泡温度偏低、质地粗糙。
why.en: The milk-pump steam check valve sticks or leaks, so steam never mixes fully at the designed point — foam runs cold and coarse.

act.zh: 关机断电拆下奶泵蒸汽单向阀，检查阀芯卡滞与密封损坏，清洁或更换，确保蒸汽与牛奶在设定位置充分混合。
act.en: Power down, remove the milk-pump steam check valve, inspect the disc for sticking/seal damage, clean or replace so steam mixes at the designed point.

why.zh: 蒸汽加热室进汽不足：蒸汽通路结垢、蒸汽三通电磁阀开闭异常或锅炉压力不足，蒸汽量不够就发不起来。
why.en: Not enough steam reaches the heating chamber — scaled steam path, a three-way steam valve that does not act, or low boiler pressure.

act.zh: 检查蒸汽三通电磁阀动作与通路；阀芯结垢拆洗或更换；确认锅炉压力与泄压正常。
act.en: Check the three-way steam valve actuation and path; clean or replace a scaled valve; confirm boiler pressure and venting.

why.zh: 转速正常但温度仍很低（约 1070 rpm 仍只有 26℃，或 830 rpm 出奶约 16℃）→ 优先判断蒸汽根本没有进入混合腔。
why.en: Pump speed normal yet the milk is still cold (~1070 rpm → only 26°C; ~830 rpm → ~16°C): first suspect that steam never enters the chamber.

act.zh: 查下壳体进蒸汽位置的不锈钢接头与单向阀是否被水垢堵塞；同时查变压装置下壳体/阀芯胀大、两通与三通隔膜阀。
act.en: Check the stainless steam-inlet fitting and the check valve for scale, plus lower-housing/diaphragm swelling and the 2-way / 3-way valves.

why.zh: 蒸汽电磁阀未打开（线圈开路或阀芯卡滞），蒸汽支路不导通。
why.en: The steam solenoid never opens (open coil or stuck disc), so the steam branch does not conduct.

act.zh: 检查阀体与线圈动作声；不通电则拆洗或更换电磁阀。
act.en: Check the coil and valve for an actuation click; if dead, strip clean or replace the solenoid.

why.zh: 进奶温度 20–30℃ 会明显影响奶泵转速与出奶温度（牛奶未冷藏）。
why.en: An inlet of 20–30°C clearly disturbs both pump speed and outlet temperature (milk not chilled).

act.zh: 门店冷藏牛奶并记录进奶温度后再复测。
act.en: Store: chill the milk, log the inlet temperature, then retest.

why.zh: 进奶 NTC 读数偏低，控制器误判进奶温度，校准基线被拉偏。
why.en: The inlet NTC reads low, so the controller misjudges the inlet and the calibration baseline is skewed.

act.zh: 清洁或更换探头，并重新做奶温校准。
act.en: Clean or replace the probe and re-run milk-temp calibration.

why.zh: 奶管时通时断（折弯、被压、半插），吸奶断续 → 出奶温度与奶量忽高忽低。
why.en: An intermittently blocked hose (kinked, pinched, half-seated) makes suction intermittent — outlet temperature and volume swing.

act.zh: 理顺奶管、固定走向、重新插到底后复测；机内奶管由服务商处理。
act.en: Straighten, route and fully reseat the hose, then retest; internal hoses are for service.

why.zh: 进奶 NTC 线束退 pin / 水腐蚀 / 接插件松动，读数跳变 → 每次校准结果都不一样。
why.en: Inlet NTC harness backed out, corroded or loose gives jumpy readings — every calibration ends differently.

act.zh: 清洁接插件并插紧后复测，观察读数是否稳定。
act.en: Clean and reseat the connectors, then retest and watch whether the reading is stable.

why.zh: 奶输送电磁阀间歇动作异常，膜片老化导致通断不稳。
why.en: The milk delivery valve actuates intermittently — an aged diaphragm opens and closes inconsistently.

act.zh: 更换 FFKM 最新膜片 / 阀体，并重新校准。
act.en: Fit the latest FFKM diaphragm/valve body and re-calibrate.

why.zh: 脉冲进气阀开合不稳定（阀芯卡滞 / 线束虚接），奶泡厚度忽厚忽薄。
why.en: The pulse air valve opens inconsistently (stuck disc / loose wiring) so foam thickness varies run to run.

act.zh: 测试模式下确认开合声；动作异常或卡滞则清洁或更换电磁阀。
act.en: Confirm the open/close sound in test mode; clean or replace the solenoid if sluggish or stuck.

why.zh: 奶路单向阀（脉冲空气阀后）密封不完全或结垢 → 背压异常、牛奶与空气混合不充分，奶温与奶量稳定性差。
why.en: The milk-line check valve (after the pulse air valve) does not seal or is scaled — abnormal back pressure makes milk and air mix poorly, hurting temperature and volume stability.

act.zh: 拆洗变压装置下壳体与混合线，更换单向阀密封件后重新校准。
act.en: Strip and clean the lower housing and mixing line, replace the check-valve seals, then re-calibrate.

why.zh: 奶量不足时吸空、奶液位探针接触不稳，进奶量在"有奶 / 吸空"之间跳变。
why.en: Low milk draws air and the level-probe contact is unstable, so the drawn amount jumps between full and empty.

act.zh: 补足奶量、清洁奶箱口与探针后复测。
act.en: Refill milk and clean the tank mouth and probe, then retest.

why.zh: 蒸汽未真正进入蒸汽混合仓：单向阀被水垢堵塞、下壳体进蒸汽接头松动或结垢 → 奶只被"走过"未被加热，出奶温度明显偏低（常见 26℃ / 16℃）。
why.en: Steam never actually enters the mixing chamber — a scaled check valve, or a loose/scaled steam-inlet fitting in the lower housing — so the milk is only carried through, never heated (often 26 °C or 16 °C).

act.zh: 服务商拆洗下壳体进蒸汽接头与单向阀，复位并紧固后重新做奶温校准。
act.en: Service strips and cleans the lower-housing steam fitting and the check valve, then refits, tightens and re-calibrates.

why.zh: 奶路单向阀卡滞／结垢造成背压异常，奶泵吃力、泵速与出奶温度同时失稳。
why.en: A stuck or scaled milk-line check valve creates abnormal back pressure — the pump works harder and both speed and outlet temperature drift.

act.zh: 拆检单向阀并清洗管路；更换后重新校准。
act.en: Strip the check valve, clean the line, replace if needed, then re-calibrate.

why.zh: 排废三通隔膜阀密封头膨胀老化 → 出奶不畅、杯量偏少（常与奶温低同时出现）。
why.en: An expanded/aged seal in the 3-way drain valve restricts the flow — low cup volume, often together with low temperature.

act.zh: 更换密封件 / 三通总成；换件后重新校准并连做出杯验证。
act.en: Replace the seal / valve assembly, re-calibrate and verify over several cups.

why.zh: 奶管被柜门压住、明显折弯或未插到底 → 负压吸奶不畅，杯量偏少。
why.en: Milk hose pinched by the cabinet door, sharply kinked or not fully seated — weak suction and low cup volume.

act.zh: 门店理顺外部奶管、确认插到底（机内奶管不得自行拆插）。
act.en: Store: straighten the external hose and confirm full seating (never open internal hoses).

why.zh: 奶箱奶量不足或吸空，泵头吸空后出奶断续、杯量明显偏少。
why.en: Tank empty or drawing air — once the pump head runs dry the flow becomes intermittent and the cup under-fills.

act.zh: 补奶、擦净奶箱口、保证牛奶冷藏 2–4℃ 后重做一杯验证。
act.en: Refill milk, wipe the tank mouth, keep milk at 2–4°C and remake one cup to verify.

why.zh: 牛奶检测探针（螺纹式）弹力不足且阻值偏大（实测 0.14 Ω，正常约 0.0012 Ω，偏大约 100 倍），导通性能变差，有奶也误报"牛奶用完"。
why.en: The milk detection probe has lost spring force and reads high (measured 0.14 Ω vs ~0.0012 Ω normal, ~100×), so a full tank still reports "milk empty".

act.zh: 清洁探针通常无效，需更换牛奶检测探针。
act.en: Cleaning the probe rarely helps — replace the milk detection probe.

why.zh: 奶泵内部单向阀与通道被奶垢或异物堵塞 → 出奶慢、杯量偏少。
why.en: Scale or debris blocks the internal check valve and passage of the milk pump — slow flow and low volume.

act.zh: 断电拆洗奶泵内部，检查单向阀与通道；复装后确认阀芯活动灵活、管路畅通。
act.en: Power down, strip and clean the pump, check the valve and passage, then confirm free movement and clear flow.

why.zh: 奶垢缩小通径（蒸汽混合仓、奶出口结垢）→ 流量整体下降。
why.en: Scale narrows the passage (mixing chamber, milk outlet) and the whole flow drops.

act.zh: 断电清洁奶出口与可见奶路；机内由服务商拆洗后重校准。
act.en: Power down and clean the outlet and visible path; service strips the internals, then re-calibrate.

why.zh: 脉冲进气阀开度偏大 / 进气过量 → 奶泡体积虚高，杯量读数偏多甚至溢杯。
why.en: The pulse air valve opens too wide or over-injects — foam volume inflates, the cup reads high and may overflow.

act.zh: 降低奶沫厚度或厚度补偿；测试模式确认阀动作量，异常则拆洗或更换。
act.en: Lower the foam thickness or thickness compensation; verify valve stroke in test mode and clean or replace it.

why.zh: 奶箱出奶口橡胶垫挤压奶管，或大奶箱抽到空气 → 奶中带气、奶泡偏多。
why.en: A rubber gasket squeezes the hose at the tank outlet, or an oversized tank draws air — aerated milk and excess foam.

act.zh: 去掉多余橡胶垫、更换合适奶箱、理顺奶管。
act.en: Remove the extra gasket, fit a proper tank and straighten the hose.

why.zh: 温度补偿调得过高 → 泵速偏低，单位时间通过混合腔的奶量与泡沫量偏差。
why.en: Temperature compensation set too high drives the pump slow, so milk and foam per unit time drift.

act.zh: 把温度补偿回到中性（20）后重新校准。
act.en: Return compensation to neutral (20) and re-calibrate.

why.zh: 配方奶量设定偏大或杯台高度不合适 —— 与泵速无关的"杯量大"。
why.en: A large recipe volume or a badly set cup rest — "too much milk" that has nothing to do with pump speed.

act.zh: 按门店标准配方核对奶量与杯台高度（改配方前先确认标准配方）。
act.en: Check volume and cup-rest height against the store standard recipe (confirm the standard before changing it).

why.zh: 脉冲空气阀故障或进气不稳定 → 气泡过大；完全打不出奶泡多数也是此阀故障。
why.en: The pulse air valve is faulty or unstable — oversized bubbles; no foam at all is usually this same valve.

act.zh: 测试模式下检查是否有清晰开合声；动作异常或卡滞则清洁或更换电磁阀。
act.en: In test mode check for a clear open/close sound; clean or replace the solenoid if sluggish or stuck.

why.zh: 奶泵模块内单向阀失效 → 蒸汽无法与牛奶充分混合，奶泡温度偏低、质地粗糙。
why.en: The internal check valve has failed — steam cannot mix properly, so foam is cold and coarse.

act.zh: 关机断电拆下奶泵蒸汽单向阀，检查阀芯卡滞或密封损坏，清洁或更换。
act.en: Power down, remove the milk-pump steam check valve, inspect the disc for sticking or seal damage, clean or replace.

why.zh: 进奶温度过高会明显影响发泡效果：热奶饮建议不高于约 10℃、冷奶饮不高于约 5℃。
why.en: Warm incoming milk clearly degrades foaming: ≤~10°C for hot drinks, ≤~5°C for cold.

act.zh: 冷藏牛奶至 2–4℃ 后复测发泡效果。
act.en: Chill the milk to 2–4°C and retest the foam.

why.zh: 杯台高度 / 出奶口位置过高（尤其 5 mm、10 mm 奶配方）→ 奶泡被拉高变粗。
why.en: Cup rest or spout set too high (notably for 5 mm / 10 mm milk recipes) stretches the foam and makes it coarse.

act.zh: 按配方建议下调杯台高度与出奶口位置后复测。
act.en: Lower the cup rest and spout position as the recipe recommends, then retest.

why.zh: 蒸汽混合仓奶垢堆积、奶出口堵塞 → 流量与流型改变，奶泡变粗或厚薄不稳。
why.en: A blocked milk outlet or scaled milk path changes flow and texture — coarse or unstable foam.

act.zh: 断电清洁奶出口与可见奶路；机内由服务商拆洗。
act.en: Power down and clean the outlet and visible path; internal cleaning is for service.

why.zh: 蒸汽锅炉三通电磁阀开闭异常或阀芯结垢 → 蒸汽量不稳，奶泡打发不充分。
why.en: The boiler three-way steam valve mis-acts or its disc is scaled — unstable steam and under-whipped foam.

act.zh: 拆洗或更换阀芯，确认蒸汽通路畅通。
act.en: Clean or replace the valve disc and confirm the steam path is clear.

why.zh: 机内奶管脱落 / 被压 / 破损会吸进空气 → 吸不上奶，或只出蒸汽不吸奶。
why.en: An internal milk hose that is off, pinched or cracked draws air — no suction, or steam only.

act.zh: 门店只做外部走线检查；机内奶管由服务商重新插紧并扎带固定。
act.en: Store checks external routing only; service reseats and straps the internal hose.

why.zh: 奶输送电磁阀未打开或内部通道堵塞 → 奶无法进入泵腔。
why.en: The milk delivery valve does not open or its passage is blocked — milk never reaches the pump chamber.

act.zh: 拆检阀体与通道；用奶泵测试菜单确认动作声。
act.en: Open and inspect the valve body and passage; confirm actuation in the milk-pump test menu.

why.zh: 热水锅炉模组奶清洗电磁阀进水管未插到位或漏水 → 蒸汽 / 水路串入奶路，表现为"只出蒸汽不吸奶"。
why.en: The hot-water boiler milk-cleaning valve inlet is not seated or leaks, so steam/water crosses into the milk path — shown as "steam only".

act.zh: 重新插紧或更换密封件，复测奶路动作与清洗流程。
act.en: Reseat or replace the seal, then retest the milk path and the wash cycle.

why.zh: 奶箱缺奶、机内管路未插到底 → 直接不出奶并报缺奶。
why.en: Empty tank or a hose not fully seated — no milk at all plus a "milk empty" alarm.

act.zh: 补奶并确认奶箱安装到位后重做一杯验证。
act.en: Refill milk, confirm the tank is seated and remake one cup to verify.

why.zh: 牛奶检测探针阻值偏大（0.14 Ω vs 正常 0.0012 Ω）→ 有奶也误报"牛奶用完"。
why.en: The milk detection probe reads ~100× too high, so a full tank still reports "milk empty".

act.zh: 更换牛奶检测探针。
act.en: Replace the milk detection probe.

why.zh: 奶泵内部单向阀与通道堵塞，泵吸不动。
why.en: The pump internal check valve and passages are blocked — the pump cannot pull.

act.zh: 断电拆洗奶泵内部，复装后确认单向阀活动灵活。
act.en: Power down, strip and clean the pump, confirm free valve movement after reassembly.

why.zh: 缺奶状态下运行导致泵头过热报故障；连续 2 秒检测到转速为 0 即报"奶泵故障"。
why.en: Running dry overheats the pump head; a 2-second zero-speed detection raises "milk pump failure".

act.zh: 门店禁止缺奶空转；服务商拆洗泵体并检查驱动电路与转速反馈。
act.en: Never run dry; service strips the pump and checks the drive circuit and speed feedback.

why.zh: 奶泵线束未插到位、端子退针、水腐蚀导致接触不良 → 转速反馈跳变报 E044 / E045。
why.en: The pump harness is unseated, backed out or corroded — intermittent speed feedback raises E044 / E045.

act.zh: 断电检查奶泵线束与 PCB 转接线束；退 pin / 水腐蚀需导入一体式线束。
act.en: Power down and check the pump harness and PCB adapter; adopt the one-piece harness where pins are backed out or corroded.

why.zh: 排奶三通阀失效导致蒸汽倒灌，损坏奶泵齿轮——必须与奶泵一并排查。
why.en: A failed 3-way drain valve lets steam back-flow and damages the pump gear — the pump must be inspected together with it.

act.zh: 在奶泵测试菜单对排奶三通阀做程序测试，有动作声才正常；失效则更换并同时检查奶泵齿轮。
act.en: Run the drain-valve program test — a click is expected; if it fails, replace it and inspect the pump gear at the same time.

why.zh: E037 奶泵系统不在位：多发生在装机、搬动或维保之后，模组线束未连接到位。
why.en: E037 milk-pump system not in position — common after installation, moving or servicing; the module harness is unseated.

act.zh: 重新安装模组并插紧线束，确认无退针、无受压。
act.en: Reinstall the module, reseat the harness and confirm no backed-out pins or pinching.

why.zh: 报"奶泵报警"后继续强行出杯会扩大损坏（严重时导致奶泵齿轮损坏）。
why.en: Continuing to dispense after a milk-pump alarm escalates the damage, including pump-gear failure.

act.zh: 立即停止使用奶路功能、正常关机断电、记录报警码与发生时机后报修。
act.en: Stop using the milk path immediately, shut down and power off, log the code and timing, then raise a ticket.

why.zh: 机内奶管接头松脱或未插到底、管口切面不平、Y 型密封圈磨损 → 奶路接口渗奶。
why.en: A loose or unseated internal milk fitting, an unevenly cut pipe end or a worn Y-seal causes seepage at the milk-path joint.

act.zh: 服务商重新插紧并扎带固定，切面不平的剪平重装；门店不得拆机插拔机内奶管。
act.en: Service reseats and straps the fitting and re-cuts uneven pipe ends; stores must not open internal hoses.

why.zh: 蒸汽混合仓与变压装置下壳体密封件 / 隔膜阀老化 → 渗奶（常伴奶温低、杯量偏少）。
why.en: Aged seals or the diaphragm valve in the lower housing leak milk — often together with low temperature and low volume.

act.zh: 更换密封件与隔膜阀，换后重新校准并观察一个班次。
act.en: Replace the seals and diaphragm valve, re-calibrate and watch one shift.

why.zh: 进水管接头松动、排水管过长 / 打折 / 上坡 → 底部或台面渗水外溢（多数被误判为漏奶）。
why.en: Loose inlet fittings or an over-long, kinked or uphill drain hose cause pooling under the machine — often mis-reported as a milk leak.

act.zh: 门店紧固外部进水接头，理顺、裁短排水管并保持缓降；清空渣盒与蓄水盘。
act.en: Store: tighten external inlet fittings, shorten and route the drain with a fall; empty the bin and drip tray.

text.zh: 查奶量与奶温（2–4℃）、奶箱是否放正、出奶口有无多余垫圈；清洁奶箱口与探针周围。
text.en: Check milk level and temperature (2–4 °C), correct tank seating and extra gaskets at the outlet; clean the tank mouth.

text.zh: 测试模式下听三通阀切换动作声；检查阀口与膜片有无结垢、膨胀或压痕。
text.en: In test mode listen for the 3-way valve switching; check ports and diaphragm for scale, swelling or imprint marks.

text.zh: 万用表测探针阻值（正常约 0.0012 Ω）；检查螺纹与弹力，擦拭探头表面后复测。
text.en: Measure the probe resistance (~0.0012 Ω normal); check thread and spring force, wipe the tip and retest.

text.zh: 万用表测 NTC 阻值并对比 IOT 显示；检查接插件是否插紧、有无退针或水腐蚀。
text.en: Measure the NTC resistance against the IOT reading; check that connectors are seated, with no backed-out or corroded pins.

text.zh: 测试模式确认两通阀开合声；拆检膜片有无膨胀/压痕，阀体通道有无结垢。
text.en: Confirm the 2-way valve click in test mode; inspect the diaphragm for swelling or imprint, the body passage for scale.

text.zh: 测试模式听进气阀开合声与节奏；检查空气滤网是否脏堵、线束连接是否牢固。
text.en: In test mode listen to the valve rhythm; check the air filter for dirt and the wiring for a tight connection.

text.zh: 拆检阀芯是否活动灵活；检查密封面结垢与磨损，确认脉冲阀后管路背压正常。
text.en: Strip the valve and confirm free disc movement; check sealing faces for scale and wear, and normal back pressure downstream.

text.zh: 读 IOT 转速并与实际对比；听泵有无异响，检查线束接插件；确认泵与阀件是否为最新 FFKM 件。
text.en: Compare the IOT RPM with actual speed; listen for noise, check harness connectors; confirm pump and valves are on the latest FFKM parts.

text.zh: 拆检蒸汽进口接头是否紧固、单向阀是否结垢；观察通蒸汽时出口温度是否快速上升。
text.en: Check that the steam-inlet fitting is tight and the check valve is clean; watch whether outlet temperature rises quickly when steam opens.

text.zh: 测试模式跑排废程序听动作声；检查密封头有无膨胀老化，排废管路是否通畅。
text.en: Run the drain program in test mode and listen for the click; check the seal head for swelling and the drain line for free flow.

text.zh: 万用表测 NTC 阻值；对比显示温度与实测出奶温度，检查探头安装位置是否正确。
text.en: Measure the NTC resistance; compare displayed vs measured outlet temperature and check probe seating.

text.zh: 通电听电磁阀动作声；测线圈电阻；拆检阀芯有无结垢或卡滞。
text.en: Listen for solenoid actuation; measure coil resistance; strip the disc for scale or sticking.

text.zh: 查看锅炉压力与温度显示是否正常；确认加热、泄压动作；观察蒸汽输出是否稳定。
text.en: Check boiler pressure and temperature readings; confirm heating and venting; watch for a steady steam supply.

text.zh: 拆下阀芯检查有无卡滞与结垢；吹气测试单向导通性；确认密封面完好。
text.en: Remove the disc and check for sticking and scale; blow-test one-way flow; confirm the sealing faces are intact.

text.zh: 测试模式听出奶选择阀动作声；拆检膜片与阀座有无膨胀压痕，检查出口通道结垢。
text.en: Listen for the outlet-select valve click in test mode; strip diaphragm and seat for swelling or imprint, check the outlet passage for scale.

text.zh: 全程检查奶管走线：有无折弯、压扁、接头松动；确认两端插到底；机内段由服务商检查。
text.en: Trace the hose end to end: kinks, flattening, loose fittings; confirm both ends fully seated; internal section is for service.
